title: One rare assignment gets a large weight
hook: Two stated cases: explore the scale of a positivity-near-boundary weight.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the scale of a positivity-near-boundary weight affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Weight, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the scale of a positivity-near-boundary weight in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
